title: 救援拖船碰撞导致伤亡
description: 救援拖船撞击玩家飞船导致船员死亡和船体破损。
evidence: the tug then proceeds to slam into my ship so hard it kills my hired crew on impact, knocks me out, and I die of hypoxia after the resulting hull breach sucks the rest of the oxygen out

evidence_items.quote: the tug then proceeds to slam into my ship so hard it kills my hired crew on impact, knocks me out, and I die of hypoxia after the resulting hull breach sucks the rest of the oxygen out
evidence_items.description: 救援拖船撞击玩家飞船导致船员死亡和船体破损
evidence_items.quote_zh: 然后那艘拖船接着猛撞我的飞船，撞得如此之狠，以至于我的雇佣船员在撞击中当场死亡，我被撞晕，而在由此产生的船体破口把剩余的氧气都吸走后，我死于缺氧
